what_is_apy.title: What is Atal Pension Yojana (APY)?
what_is_apy.body: The Atal Pension Yojana (APY) is a government-backed pension scheme in India, primarily targeted at workers in the unorganized sector. It encourages small savings for retirement and guarantees a fixed monthly pension of â‚¹1,000, â‚¹2,000, â‚¹3,000, â‚¹4,000, or â‚¹5,000 after the age of 60.
points: Guaranteed Pension: Provides a fixed pension, offering financial security in old age.
Government Co-contribution: For eligible subscribers, the government co-contributes 50% of the total contribution or â‚¹1,000 per annum, whichever is lower, for the first 5 years.
Eligibility: Open to all Indian citizens between 18 and 40 years of age with a bank account.

how_it_works.title: How the APY Calculator Works
how_it_works.intro: The APY premium is fixed based on your entry age and desired pension. The earlier you start, the lower your monthly contribution. Our calculator uses the official premium chart provided by the PFRDA to give you the exact amount.

example.title: Example Calculation
example.body: If you are 25 years old and want a pension of â‚¹5,000 per month, your required monthly contribution would be just â‚¹376. You would contribute this amount for 35 years (until age 60).
example.note: This fixed premium makes it easy to budget and plan for your retirement savings consistently.

enrollment.title: How to Enroll in APY
enrollment.intro: Enrolling in APY is simple and can be done through your bank or post office where you have a savings account. The steps are:
steps: Visit your bank branch or post office.
Fill out the APY registration form.
Provide your Aadhaar and mobile number.
Link your savings account for auto-debit of the monthly contribution.

comparison.title: APY vs. NPS vs. PPF vs. Other Pension Schemes
comparison.body:
While APY provides a guaranteed pension, it's important to compare it with other popular schemes like the National Pension System (NPS), Public Provident Fund (PPF), Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY), and UPS Pension Scheme. APY is ideal for those seeking a fixed, secure pension with low contributions, whereas NPS offers market-linked returns with higher growth potential, and PPF is a long-term savings tool with tax-free returns. For a direct comparison between FD and PPF, use our FD vs PPF calculator.

Use our retirement corpus calculator to plan your overall retirement strategy, and compare different tax regimes to maximize your savings.

rules.title: Key Rules and Conditions of APY
rules.body:
• The subscriber must contribute for a minimum of 20 years.
  • Premature withdrawal is only allowed in case of terminal illness or death.
  • If the subscriber dies before age 60, the spouse can continue the contributions or exit the scheme.
  • The pension amount is guaranteed by the Government of India.

faqs.question: What is the maximum age to join the APY scheme?
faqs.answer: The maximum age to join the Atal Pension Yojana is 40 years.

faqs.question: Can I increase or decrease my pension amount later?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can change your desired pension amount once a year, in the month of April.

faqs.question: What happens if I miss a contribution?
faqs.answer: A penalty is charged for delayed contributions. The penalty is â‚¹1 per month for a contribution of â‚¹100, and so on.

faqs.question: Is the pension from APY taxable?
faqs.answer: Yes, the pension received under APY is considered as income and is taxable as per the applicable income tax slabs. You can use our tax regime calculator to check your slab.

faqs.question: How does APY compare with LIC pension plans?
faqs.answer: Unlike LIC plans that depend on market performance, APY provides a guaranteed pension backed by the Government of India. Check our LIC premium calculator for comparison.

faqs.question: Can I withdraw money before retirement?
faqs.answer: Premature withdrawal is only allowed in exceptional cases like terminal illness or death. Otherwise, you must contribute until age 60.

faqs.question: What is the minimum and maximum pension amount?
faqs.answer: You can choose monthly pensions of â‚¹1,000, â‚¹2,000, â‚¹3,000, â‚¹4,000, or â‚¹5,000 after retirement.

faqs.question: How can I calculate LIC insurance premiums for comparison?
faqs.answer: For comparing APY with LIC pension plans, use our LIC premium calculator to estimate costs for various LIC schemes like Jeevan Anand or Jeevan Umang.

faqs.question: What if I want to check overlap in my mutual fund investments?
faqs.answer: If you're considering mutual funds alongside APY, use our mutual fund overlap calculator to avoid redundant investments and optimize your portfolio.

faqs.question: Are there calculators for LIC child plans or term insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have specialized calculators for LIC child plans, LIC term insurance, and other LIC schemes to help you compare options.
